2] Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the respondent - State.
Perused the First Information Report and order 7.8.2020 passed by learned Additional Sessions Judge.

] By referring the overall facts of the case and accusations made against the applicant, the learned counsel submits that as per the prosecution case, raid was conducted on 27.7.2020 in the shop and godown located near Bus Stand, Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli belonging to Afroz Pathan - present applicant on information that the contraband articles like scented tobacco, Gutkha, Pan Masala of brand name Vimal, Goa and Pan Parag were stored in the shop for sale.
While conducting raid, the person by name Shaikh Musabir Shaikh Shabbir was present in the shop.
In the search made in the shop, huge quantity of contraband articles were seized.
The shop was belonging to the applicant.
4] It is submitted that the applicant is not the owner of the shop.
There is no evidence to show that the premises where the raid was conducted was owned and belonged to applicant.
It i submitted that even if the allegations in the First Information Report are accepted in their entirety, still they make out no ofence u/s 328 of the Indian Penal Code.

By referring the Division Bench decision of this Court in the case of Anand Ramdhani Chaurasia & another v.
State of Maharashtra & others (2019 DGLS (Bom.) 1020), the Afroz Khan S/O. Zahed Khan Pathan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 11 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130922898/

It is submitted  ::: Uploaded on - 11/09/2020 ::: Downloaded on - 12/09/2020 09:08:29 :
- 3- that mere possession or storage of such articles are not sufcient to attract the ofence registered against the applicant.
5] On the other hand, learned APP opposed the application with contention that huge quantity of contraband articles were seized during the raid conducted in the shop premises belonging to applicant.

It is submitted that in the State of Maharashtra, by virtue of the orders issued under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, sale, possession and consumption of Gutkha and Pan Parag is prohibited.
In contravention of the prohibitory orders in force, the applicant is found to have stored huge quantity of contraband articles for sale.
The applicant is habitually indulged into ofences of such nature.
Previously number of cases were registered against the applicant involving commission of similar ofences.
6] On due consideration of the submissions advanced, I am of the view that the case is made out to entertain the application.
Except the ofence u/s 328 of the Indian Penal Code, all other ofences are bailable.
It is a debatable issue as to whether mere possession or storage of said contraband articles for sale itself is Afroz Khan S/O.

 ABA 689/2020  - 4-  ORDER  A] The application is allowed.

B] In the event of arrest of the applicant in connection with ofences registered u/s 188, 272, 273 & 328 of the Indian Penal Code registered vide Crime No.260/2020 with Police Station, Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli, the applicant be released on furnishing bail in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with one or two sureties in the like amount on following conditions:-
i] The applicant shall appear before the investigating ofcer from 15.9.2020 to 18.9.2020 in between 11-00 to 3-00 p.m. and cooperate in investigation.
ii] Till fling of charge-sheet, the applicant shall appear before ofcer in-charge of Police Station, Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli on every Sunday in between 10-00 to 11-00 a.m. to record his appearance.
iii] In case charge-sheet is fled against the applicant, the applicant shall record his appearance before ofcer in-charge of concerned Police Station on last day of each month in - 5- between 5-00 p.m. to 6-00 p.m. till conclusion of trial.
iv] Pending disposal of the case, the applicant shall not indulge into any ofence of similar in nature.
C] In case the applicant fails to abide by any of the conditions imposed, the prosecution will be at liberty to apply for cancellation of bail.
D] The application is disposed of in above terms.
